title: A more complete History
summary: History now knows where plays came from, travels through native CSV backups, and feeds more accurate Statistics. Now Playing adds deeper stream details without crowding its cards.
highlights: See each item's real Jellyfin library. A one-time update safely matches older History after upgrading.
Export all History or a filtered selection to a portable Jellydash CSV, with an exact preview first.
Restore or move Jellydash CSV backups from Settings with a preview, duplicate detection, and transactional importing.
See bitrate, codecs, containers, output formats, and transcode reasons from compact Now Playing cards.
Get more accurate watch times, averages, user shares, playback percentages, and complete category totals in Statistics.
Keep Recently Added positioned correctly on Android after refreshing or returning to the app.
